node.description: Authoring recovery for the existing model-catalog delivery: consume the canonical RequestContext, authorization/admission, AuditEvent, and Credential contracts; remove production bypasses and every duplicate manual model/snapshot/digest path from core; and close the rejected concurrency, recovery, provenance, and fail-closed transport boundaries without changing adjacent owners or requiring an unmaterialized upstream artifact.

contract.objective: Deliver the governed Model Catalog boundary for provider connections, discovery snapshots, snapshot-scoped probes, and exact selection: require authenticated RequestContext, scope, authorization/admission, canonical audit evidence, and mandatory scope-bound egress before credential use; atomically bind mutations to canonical audit/outbox facts, durably finalize attempted probes, reject stale publication by connection revision/digest and predecessor CAS, and contain no manual model definition, AddManualModel, manual snapshot, or manual digest authority; the immutable model-manual owner remains separate and api-model composes both owners downstream.
non_goals: Do not modify internal/modelcatalog/manual/**, migrate model-manual ownership, consume or regenerate a model-manual component manifest, or define Model, Snapshot, AddManualModel, manual merge, or manual content digest behavior inside model-catalog. Do not create a conformance-artifact handoff when the authoritative removal option eliminates that input; any supplied model-manual artifact is outside the explicit `consumes: []` boundary and must fail closed.

Do not move RequestContext, authorization, admission, canonical AuditEvent, CredentialBroker, or durable outbox ownership into model-catalog, and do not introduce feature-local replacements for those platform facts.

Do not retain exported ungoverned production constructors, fallback actor/scope paths, origin-only default egress, credential materialization before policy approval, or public concrete store writers that bypass the governed application protocol.

Do not persist caller-controlled raw strings as non-secret headers, place Secret material in connection state or digests, leak credentials or raw provider errors, or weaken fail-closed classification at the HTTP adapter.

Do not publish a snapshot without atomic current-connection revision/configuration-digest and predecessor checks, key probe evidence without ModelCatalogSnapshotID, or leave an attempted provider call as an unrecoverable in-progress claim.

Do not add a generic provider/plugin runtime, make an external provider the source of truth, change northbound API/UI ownership, or broaden source ownership beyond internal/modelcatalog/core/** and internal/modelcatalog/providers/** plus exact tests and generated evidence.

review_obligations.requirement: Ownership, boundaries, and unique write paths
Prior blocker regression and changed-scope review

blocker_facts.summary: A provider timeout returns before saving a failed/unknown probe, leaving an older success selectable.
blocker_facts.evidence: providers/http.go:119-127 maps timeout to context.DeadlineExceeded; application.go:367-370 returns before probe persistence; selection accepts the old successful key.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Persist a redacted failed/unknown observation or invalidate prior success and define safe retry semantics for an unknown external outcome.

blocker_facts.summary: SelectModel ignores requested snapshot provenance and resolves LatestSnapshot.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:398-450 reads LatestSnapshot at line 409 and never consumes SelectModelRequest.ModelCatalogSnapshotID.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Separate browse-latest from exact resolution and require a stable snapshot plus fixed revision/digest for materialization.

blocker_facts.summary: Exact selection checks only Probe.Outcome after FindProbe and not the returned provenance fields.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:427-436 trusts the store result; ProbeKey at types.go:445-450 defines the fields that must match.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Validate and compare connection, revision, digest, model, and API type on every returned probe.

blocker_facts.summary: Sensitive non-secret headers are protected by an incomplete denylist.
blocker_facts.evidence: core/types.go:725-748 and providers/http.go:155-190 accept unlisted credential-bearing header names and values that are persisted and transmitted.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Use an explicit safe-header allowlist or typed CredentialBinding mapping at both core and adapter boundaries, with regression tests.

blocker_facts.summary: The PR duplicates manual snapshot merge/validation beside the existing manual package.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/modelcatalog/manual/manual.go:62-232 and core/application.go:243-284,567-592 define separate manual publication behavior and core/types.go:249-367 defines a second digest contract.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Select one canonical manual snapshot contract and adapt or retire the other implementation.

blocker_facts.summary: Governed commands lack authenticated RequestContext, authorization/admission, and canonical audit ownership.
blocker_facts.evidence: core/types.go:171-193 accepts scope/actor fields from input; application.go:54-117 writes directly; no authorization/audit port exists.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Derive scope and actor from authenticated context, invoke authorization/admission, and emit connection and credential-use audit evidence.

blocker_facts.summary: Manual fallback copies discovered entries across changed connection provenance.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:261-275 loads prior snapshot without provenance filtering; manualSuccessorModels at 567-592 clones every prior model.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Carry forward only manual/mixed entries when revision/configuration changes; retain discovered entries only with matching provenance.

blocker_facts.summary: HTTP connectors can use an unrestricted default client against any HTTP(S) host and follow redirects.
blocker_facts.evidence: core/types.go:710-722 validates only URI shape; providers/http.go:42-60 defaults to &http.Client{} and 99-119 sends without an egress/origin policy.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Require a scope-bound policy-enforcing resolver/transport and reject or validate redirects before credential injection.

blocker_facts.summary: Connector-supplied sanitized error fields and ProviderError summaries are persisted without central redaction.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:367-380 and 654-660 copy connector fields; types.go:426-431 checks formatting only, not safe content or cardinality.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Use typed low-cardinality error categories or central fail-closed sanitization before persistence and exposure.

blocker_facts.summary: Read-then-append snapshot publication has no predecessor CAS or idempotency.
blocker_facts.evidence: application.go:220-235 and 268-283 read LatestSnapshot then SaveSnapshot; store.go:99-118 only appends, so concurrent manual updates can lose entries.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Add atomic expected-predecessor publication and stable command idempotency, including test-message retry semantics.

blocker_facts.summary: A caller context deadline still returns before persisting an unknown probe, so an older successful probe can remain selectable.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:459-470 returns immediately when ctx.Err() is context.DeadlineExceeded; probe persistence occurs only at :485-495, while selection accepts ProbeSucceeded at :563-572.

The governed application now requires a supplied EgressPolicy and checks it before credential resolution at application.go:270-280 and :459-464, but direct exported provider constructors still use the permissive default, and providers/http.go:104-115 evaluates its policy after the connector has already received the credential lease.
blockers.required_fix: Require a scope-bound policy/resolver at the provider construction boundary or make provider construction internal to the governed composition path. Fail closed when absent, enforce the same policy before credential resolution/injection, and keep redirect rejection/revalidation tied to it.
blockers.last_evidence: Governed application preflight now checks a supplied policy before lease resolution, but providers/http.go:61-70 still installs a permissive origin-only default and direct provider constructors remain callable with a credential lease.

blockers.summary: SendTestMessage can return a connector-supplied error verbatim on timeout paths even though stored probe fields are canonicalized.
blockers.evidence: The timeout branches return connectorErr directly at internal/modelcatalog/core/application.go:459-465 and :504-505; ProviderError.Error exposes its Summary at types.go:722-735. The connector port accepts arbitrary implementations, so a wrapped timeout can carry unredacted text to the caller.
blockers.required_fix: Return only canonical context/provider error categories from every application path, including unknown-timeout responses; never return a connector error object directly across the application boundary.
blockers.last_evidence: Current connector errors are canonicalized through canonicalConnectorError/providerErrorFrom and stored via SafeProviderError at application.go:550-570; the declared provider/core redaction tests pass.

blockers.summary: Legacy concrete writers remain callable, and publication does not verify that the connection revision is still current.
blockers.evidence: SnapshotStore no longer lists SaveSnapshot, but the public concrete MemoryStore still exposes SaveSnapshot at store.go:112-132 and SaveProbe at :238-252, plus SaveProbeWithIdempotency at :351-378. Separately, DiscoverModels reads a connection at application.go:252-260, performs external discovery, and publishes using only the snapshot predecessor at :292-320; MemoryStore.PublishSnapshot at store.go:138-175 never compares the snapshot revision/digest with the current stored connection.
blockers.required_fix: Remove or test-scope all legacy append/overwrite writers. Make publication atomically require the expected connection revision/configuration digest as well as the predecessor and command key, and reject stale in-flight discoveries/manual publications.
blockers.last_evidence: Application publication now uses predecessor CAS and requires a probe idempotency key, but public MemoryStore SaveSnapshot/SaveProbe bypasses remain and publication still lacks a current connection revision CAS.

contract.objective: Deliver the governed Model Catalog boundary for provider connections, discovery snapshots, snapshot-scoped probes, and exact selection: require authenticated RequestContext, scope, authorization/admission, canonical audit evidence, and mandatory scope-bound egress before credential use; atomically bind mutations to canonical audit/outbox facts, durably finalize attempted probes, reject stale publication by connection revision/digest and predecessor CAS, and contain no manual model definition, AddManualModel, manual snapshot, or manual digest authority; the immutable model-manual owner remains separate and api-model composes both owners downstream.
non_goals: Do not modify internal/modelcatalog/manual/**, migrate model-manual ownership, consume or regenerate a model-manual component manifest, or define Model, Snapshot, AddManualModel, manual merge, or manual content digest behavior inside model-catalog. Do not create a conformance-artifact handoff when the authoritative removal option eliminates that input; any supplied model-manual artifact is outside the explicit `consumes: []` boundary and must fail closed.

Do not move RequestContext, authorization, admission, canonical AuditEvent, CredentialBroker, or durable outbox ownership into model-catalog, and do not introduce feature-local replacements for those platform facts.

Do not retain exported ungoverned production constructors, fallback actor/scope paths, origin-only default egress, credential materialization before policy approval, or public concrete store writers that bypass the governed application protocol.

Do not persist caller-controlled raw strings as non-secret headers, place Secret material in connection state or digests, leak credentials or raw provider errors, or weaken fail-closed classification at the HTTP adapter.

Do not publish a snapshot without atomic current-connection revision/configuration-digest and predecessor checks, key probe evidence without ModelCatalogSnapshotID, or leave an attempted provider call as an unrecoverable in-progress claim.

Do not add a generic provider/plugin runtime, make an external provider the source of truth, change northbound API/UI ownership, or broaden source ownership beyond internal/modelcatalog/core/** and internal/modelcatalog/providers/** plus exact tests and generated evidence.
